item.title: Israel-Iran Conflict: Iran War Live Updates: Trump Says Iranians Face ‘Big Hurdle’ to Overthrowing Regime
item.summary: Two weeks after calling for Iranians to rise up against their autocratic government, the president on Friday expressed skepticism they could succeed right now.

item.title: How the War in Iran Could Help China and Change Asia

item.title: To Fight Iran’s Drones, U.S. Taps Ukraine’s Hard-Earned Knowledge
item.summary: As Iran has shown, warfare involves far more deadly projectiles than it once did. It’s a problem Ukraine has been dealing with for years.

item.title: A Visit to a Temple at the Heart of the Thailand-Cambodia Conflict
item.summary: A rare visit to a Khmer temple on Thailand and Cambodia’s border showed how deadly clashes between the two countries have scarred a heritage site.

item.title: U.S. Sanctions Pause Adds Political Win to Russia’s Economic Gain From Iran War
item.summary: Kremlin officials said the American move, which Europe opposes, showed that Moscow could not be dislodged from the center of global energy markets.

item.title: Iran’s Frantic Attempt to Save Its Ships Before Torpedo Attack
item.summary: The Iranian Navy sought refuge in Sri Lanka and India. While India obliged, Sri Lanka stalled over fears it would threaten its neutrality.

item.title: More Marines and Warships Being Sent to Middle East, U.S. Officials Say
item.summary: Iran’s response to days of aerial bombardment and long-range artillery strikes has proved more resilient than Trump administration officials anticipated.

item.title: U.S.-made Launcher Fired Missiles From Bahrain Toward Iran, Video Shows
item.summary: It is unclear from the video alone whether the U.S. or Bahraini military launched the missiles. Iran has frequently accused Persian Gulf countries of allowing their territory to be used as a launchpad for U.S. attacks.

item.title: Drone Strike Has Cyprus, and Europe, on Edge
item.summary: Allies have rushed to defend the Mediterranean nation, where the drone hit a British base. Some Cypriots wonder why the bases are still there.

item.title: Israel Drops Case Against Soldiers Accused of Abusing Palestinian Detainee
